# Getting help

This repository holds update feeds only. Where to go depends on what you are asking
about.

- **A question about District AI, the product** (your account, a phone number, billing,
  the service's behaviour): <https://www.distronode.com/support>.
- **A bug in District AI for macOS, including its updates:**
  [district-macos Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-macos/issues).
- **A question about the code:**
  [district-macos Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-macos/discussions).
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/updates/security/advisories/new),
  or email opensource@distronode.com if you cannot use GitHub. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
